controles.verbatim_source: "for so long as MTIC, MTIIIC and certain of their affiliates (the 'Mubadala Entities'), in the aggregate, beneficially own 50% or more of the ordinary shares held by the Mubadala Entities upon consummation of our IPO, MTIC will be entitled to nominate a number of designees ... representing a majority of our directors"
